source: No provider prices are bundled. Add an operator-verified rate for the exact model id before a budget-capped paid run. Do not paste guessed or placeholder numbers.

rate_fields.model_id: Exact billed model id; must match PGWHITE_SELECTOR_MODEL / --model
rate_fields.reasoning_usd_per_million: Optional; required if the provider reports reasoning tokens
rate_fields.cached_input_usd_per_million: Optional; required if the provider reports cached tokens

notes: USD totals are computed after a call from reported tokens and a matching catalog rate. Missing tokens or missing rates stay unknown; nothing is imputed.
max_estimated_budget_usd is a post-call estimated-spend stop, not a guaranteed pre-call cap. A single request can still exceed the budget. Unknown usage on any completed call blocks later calls.
Use max_requests as the hard pre-call limit. The OpenAI pilot config sets max_estimated_budget_usd to 1.00, which refuses to start until a matching verified rate exists.
